mistake_content: Test method 'test_03_verify_the_position_of_the_buttons_on_the_cancel_shortcut_creation_pop_up_window_C48' is missing the required docstring with TestRail URL. The method only has a comment '# LOCAL MISTAKE: Missing docstring with TestRail URL' instead of a properly formatted docstring. According to HPX automation standards, all test methods MUST include a docstring with a description and TestRail link in the format: triple-quoted string with description on first line, blank line, and 'TestRails -> [URL]' on the third line.
solution:
Add the proper docstring immediately after the test method definition. Replace the comment '# LOCAL MISTAKE: Missing docstring with TestRail URL' with the following docstring:

```python
def test_03_verify_the_position_of_the_buttons_on_the_cancel_shortcut_creation_pop_up_window_C48(self):
    """
    Verify the buttons of cancel shortcut creation pop up window.

    TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/48
    """
```

This follows the HPX standard format where:
- Line 1: Description of what the test verifies
- Line 2: Blank line
- Line 3: TestRail link using the pattern 'TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/<case_id>' where case_id matches the C48 suffix in the test method name.

mistake_content: Test method 'test_04_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_clicks_on_go_back_button' is missing the required TestRail case ID suffix '_C49'. According to HPX framework naming conventions in Section 7.1 (STANDARD TEST FILE STRUCTURE), all test methods MUST include the TestRail case ID suffix in the format '_C<testrail_id>' to ensure traceability between automated tests and TestRail test cases.
solution:
Rename the test method from 'test_04_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_clicks_on_go_back_button' to 'test_04_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_clicks_on_go_back_button_C49' to include the TestRail case ID suffix. The complete corrected method signature should be:

```python
def test_04_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_clicks_on_go_back_button_C49(self):
    """
    Verify the screen when user clicks go back.
    TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/49
    """
    # Test implementation
```

This ensures proper traceability and follows the naming convention pattern used by all other test methods in the class (test_01_..._C46, test_02_..._C47, test_03_..._C48, test_05_..._C50, test_06_..._C51).
